candidates.title: Hourly Production Rate and Cumulative Output
candidates.rationale: Uses 'slot_ts' as the temporal X axis to show the trend of '時間当' (hourly production rate) and '累計' (cumulative total) over time, directly addressing the Line-12 hourly production feature.
candidates.conditions: Always recommended for viewing temporal trends in production metrics.

candidates.title: Distribution of Hourly Production Rates
candidates.rationale: Analyzes the spread and outliers of '時間当' (hourly production rate), revealing variability in hourly output performance across the shift.
candidates.conditions: When checking distribution of hourly production rates.

candidates.title: Distribution of Net Time Seconds
candidates.rationale: Analyzes the spread of '正味時間秒' (net time seconds), revealing the distribution of actual working time duration per slot.
candidates.conditions: When checking distribution of net time seconds.

candidates.title: Hourly Output and Cumulative Total
candidates.rationale: Uses '時間当' (hourly good qty) and '累計' (running cumulative qty) to show the production trend over time and the accumulation of total output.
candidates.conditions: Always show when analyzing hourly production trends.

candidates.title: New Build Production by Model
candidates.rationale: Uses 'FD03[7]', 'FD32[8]', and 'FD31[9]' to visualize the separate output of new builds (models 7, 8, 9) over time, adhering to the requirement to split new builds from rework.
candidates.conditions: Always show when analyzing new build performance.

candidates.title: Distribution of Hourly Output
candidates.rationale: Uses '時間当' to reveal the spread of hourly production rates, identifying modes and outliers in the hourly output performance.
candidates.conditions: When checking distribution of hourly output.
